outlets.name: MICHELIN Guide Chicago (stars + Bib Gourmand)
outlets.credible: International culinary authority; Chicago has had a full MICHELIN guide since 2011. Any distinction is institutional ground truth on its own.

outlets.name: James Beard Foundation Awards (incl. America's Classics)
outlets.credible: National culinary authority (headquartered its awards gala in Chicago); winners, nominees and America's Classics honorees are institutional marks.

outlets.name: National Park Service
outlets.credible: Federal operator of Pullman National Historical Park and Indiana Dunes National Park — ground truth for sites it runs.

outlets.name: UNESCO World Heritage — The 20th-Century Architecture of Frank Lloyd Wright
outlets.credible: World Heritage inscription (2019) includes Robie House (Hyde Park) and Unity Temple (Oak Park).

outlets.name: Chicago Tribune (incl. Louisa Chu, Nick Kindelsperger food coverage)
outlets.credible: Chicago's daily of record since 1847; bylined restaurant criticism and food reporting.

outlets.name: Chicago Sun-Times
outlets.credible: The city's second daily of record (nonprofit, with WBEZ); bylined food and neighborhood coverage.

outlets.name: Chicago Magazine (Best New Restaurants, 50 Best Things to Eat, Best Pizza)
outlets.credible: The city magazine of record since 1968; long-running ranked dining lists and critics.

outlets.name: Eater Chicago
outlets.credible: Bylined Chicago food news, the Eater 38 essential map and heatmaps.

outlets.name: The Infatuation Chicago
outlets.credible: Bylined, critic-rated restaurant reviews and guides for Chicago.

outlets.name: Block Club Chicago
outlets.credible: Nonprofit neighborhood newsroom; the go-to for openings/closings and neighborhood institutions in every community area.

outlets.name: WTTW (Chicago PBS) — incl. Geoffrey Baer architecture tours, Check, Please!
outlets.credible: Chicago's PBS station; long-running Check, Please! restaurant show and Geoffrey Baer's architecture/neighborhood specials.

outlets.name: WBEZ Chicago (NPR)
outlets.credible: Chicago's NPR station; bylined culture/history coverage (Curious City).

outlets.name: Chicago Reader
outlets.credible: Chicago's alt-weekly since 1971 (Mike Sula food writing); nightlife/music and immigrant-food depth.

outlets.name: Time Out Chicago
outlets.credible: Notable international city-guide brand; bylined Chicago best-of lists.

outlets.name: Choose Chicago (official CVB)
outlets.credible: The city's official tourism board; neighborhood and attraction guides.

outlets.name: Atlas Obscura — Chicago
outlets.credible: The curated oddities backbone; editor-reviewed entries.

outlets.name: Chicago Architecture Center
outlets.credible: The city's architecture nonprofit (river cruise, Open House Chicago); authority on its buildings.

outlets.name: Wikipedia
outlets.credible: Notability + published coordinates for landmarks (NRHP / Chicago Landmark status cited).

outlets.name: The place's own official site
outlets.credible: Authority on its own address, hours and status; never a lone recommender.

outlets.name: Chicago Park District
outlets.credible: Operator of the city's parks, beaches, conservatories — authority on those sites.

outlets.name: Chicagoist (WBEZ)
outlets.credible: Chicago culture/news site (revived under WBEZ); corroborating.

outlets.name: The New York Times
outlets.credible: National paper of record; Restaurant List and travel (36 Hours) coverage.

outlets.name: Thrillist
outlets.credible: National food/travel site with bylined city lists; corroborating only.
